requirements.description: Aligned sub-dword write offset/size mapping (including 8'h30 -> offset 4) and unaligned/sparse 64-bit write byte walking with termination after the highest asserted byte lane.
Streaming AXI read error transition (STREAM_RD -> STREAM_ERR_RD -> DATA_RD) and SLVERR response with {2{last_bus_addr}} read data.
Two-cycle AHB-Lite error protocol (HRESP=1, HREADYOUT=0 then HRESP=1, HREADYOUT=1) on out-of-range, unaligned word/dword, illegal ICCM/DCCM size, or read ECC error, clearing cmdbuf_vld on read error.

64-bit single-word strobe (8'hf0/8'h0f) address/size normalization, illegal strobe alignment DECERR reporting, QoS NACK counter stall persistence, wrbuf/rdbuf alternating priority, and upper-word debug read extraction.

Latch-free synthesis <= 12,350.0 um^2, registered WNS/WHS >= 0.00 ns at 5.60/6.00 ns clock with 2.50 ns input and 2.00 ns output external delays, and exact 1.65 ns (qos) / 2.45 ns (region) internal combinational budgets.
